hero.title: How Breathe guides your body into calm
hero.subtitle: A closer look at the breathing science, rhythm presets, and offline-first design behind every session.
lead.body: Breathing on a slower, longer-exhale rhythm is one of the fastest ways to shift your nervous system from alert to relaxed, and Breathe builds every feature around making that rhythm easy to follow.
split-1.title: A longer exhale tells your body it's safe
split-1.body: Slowing your exhale activates the vagus nerve and lowers heart rate. Breathe's presets are tuned around this ratio, so you don't have to count seconds yourself.
split-2.title: Every preset maps to a specific goal
split-2.body: Balance, Relax, Energy, and Sleep each use a different inhale/exhale ratio. Pick a goal and Breathe handles the timing, or build a custom rhythm of your own.
steps.title: How a session flows
steps.subtitle: From opening the app to the moment your shoulders drop.
item-1.title: Pick a background
item-1.body: Choose a video or photo atmosphere, downloaded once for offline use.
item-2.title: Choose a rhythm
item-2.body: Select a preset or dial in a custom inhale and exhale timing.
item-3.title: Start breathing
item-3.body: Follow the pulsing circle and let the app hold the pace.
item-4.title: See your summary
item-4.body: Get a short session summary and save your favorite selections.
cta.title: Take a breath. The good kind.
cta.body: A few minutes is all it takes. Download Breathe and start your first session today.
